title: Bombay High Court denies urgent relief to Phantom Studios in suit against JioStar over Queen sequel
description: The Bombay High Court on Thursday refused to grant urgent interim relief to Phantom Studios in its ₹250 crore suit over the film Queen Forever which Phantom claims is an unauthorised sequel to the 2014 film Queen [Phantom Studios v. JioStar India & Ors].The matter was mentioned before Justice Gauri Godse by counsel for Phantom seeking urgent listing of the matter so that orders can be passed to restrain JioStar from creating third-party rights in the film, including distribution deals.
